description: Retained public Nerf Watch score history for one model, oldest first, including each point's suite version. The required model id is available from get_nerfwatch_scores. Missing days are missing, not zero; comparisons are within one suite version. A lower score is a lower score on this suite, not proof that a provider changed a model. Unofficial, not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic. Source: https://tokenusage.dev/nerfwatch

model.description: A model id from get_nerfwatch_scores: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

name: get_nerfwatch_history

dataUpdatedAt.description: When the newest retained run across the dataset was stored, ISO 8601 UTC; null without runs. This is dataset metadata, not a timestamp for this model alone.

generatedAt.description: When the cached data was read, ISO 8601 UTC; the cache TTL is 300 seconds from read start.

history.description: Retained points, oldest first, including older suite versions; days without a run are missing, not zero.

score.description: The suite percentage, rounded to two decimals.

suiteVersion.description: The suite version; score comparisons are within one version.

historyDays.description: The returned retention bound per model; clients read this setting rather than assuming 366.

name.description: The selected model's published display name.

provider.description: The selected model's published provider name.

source.description: The fixed credit URL, https://tokenusage.dev/nerfwatch. When showing the data to other people, show Data: tokenusage.dev linked to this URL on the same screen or in the same message. Personal use needs no visible credit. API and MCP relays must retain source and pass on this credit condition.

title: Nerf Watch history
